description: What the app's notification centre shows: the background jobs you started that are running or finished recently (test generation, reports, sorting test categories, explorations and the like; admins also see jobs nobody started), each with its id, kind, status, progress, result or error, plus the test runs in the organization that are running or finished in the last hours. Use it to see what is still working before starting more, or to find a job's id for cancel_job.

project.description: Only this project's jobs and runs (number or name). Leave out for all.
